plan.goal: Reclassify float32 mask raster to binary (0/1) then polygonize to vector, avoiding overly aggressive filtering that removed the valid polygon in the previous attempt
plan.notes: The float32 raster uses nodata value -3.4028234663852886e+38. First reclassify valid pixels to value 1 and nodata to 0 to create a clean binary mask. Then polygonize the binary raster. Do NOT apply post-polygonization artifact filtering that was removing the single valid polygon. Output CRS must match EPSG:32733.
